dea-ini-001.text: A data team needs to deliver click events from a site directly to Amazon S3, without writing or managing consumer applications, accepting delivery latency of about 1 What service was designed exactly for this ENTREGA managed streaming?
dea-ini-001.explanation: A) Incorrect: SQS is point-to-point message queue, no streaming delivery on data lake. B) Correct: Firehose is the fully managed delivery service: receives, buffers and deposits in S3 (or Redshift/OpenSearch) without consumer code. C) Incorrect: Crawler discovers scheme and catalog metadata — does not ingest data. D) Incorrect: Data Streams is the raw INGESTÃO layer — requires you to build and operate consumers.

dea-ini-002.text: Which destinations or Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose can deliver NATIVAMENTE, no custom code?
options: Only related banks like RDS and Aurora
Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, Amazon OpenSearch Service and endpoints HTTP of partners
dea-ini-002.explanation: A) Incorrect: RDS/Aurora are not native to Firehose. S3 is the most common destination, but not the only one. C) Correct: Firehose delivers natively in S3, Redshift, OpenSearch and destinations HTTP/partners (Datatog, Spunk etc.). D) Incorrect: DynamoDB It's not Firehose's destiny..

dea-ini-003.text: A company has thousands of files CSV and JSON no S3 and want to automatically discover the schema of these data and register them as consultable tables. AWS Glue makes this discovery and cataloguing?
options: Glue Crawler, recording the tables in Glue Catalogue Date
dea-ini-003.explanation: A) Incorrect: the Registration Scheme versions schemas of STREAMING (Open/JSON in Kafka/Kinesis). B) Incorrect: Studio is the visual editor of jobs ETL. C) Correct: Crawler sweeps or S3, infer the schema and create/update tables in the Data Catalog — the central catalog used by Athena, EMR and Redshift Spectrum. D) Incorrect: DataBrew is visual data preparation for analysts.

dea-ini-004.text: What is the best description of the service AWS Glue in the context of a data pipeline?
options: A line service to unplug microservices
A service of ETL Apache Spark based serverless, with integrated metadata catalog
A columnar data warehouse for analytical queries
dea-ini-004.explanation: A) Incorrect: this is the description of the Amazon MSK. B) Incorrect: this is the description of the SQS. (c) Correct: or Glue implements jobs of ETL in Spark without cluster to manage, charging for DPU-D) Incorrect: this is the description of the Redshift.

dea-ini-005.text: A company needs to continuously replicate an Oracle on-premises database for the AWS, keeping the origin in operation throughout the process. Which service is specialized in this migration and replication of BANCOS Data?
dea-ini-005.explanation: A) Incorrect: Snowball is physical transfer of large volumes of files. B) Incorrect: AppFlow integrates data from SaaS applications, not on-premises banks. C) Correct: the DMS migrates and replicates databases with source in the air, including full load + CDC (D) Incorrect: DataSync transfer ARQUIVOS/objects (NFS, SMB, S3), no replica banks.

dea-ini-006.text: The data team needs to bring Salesforce records to the Amazon S3 daily, without writing integration code. Which service solves this data intake of SaaS applications?
dea-ini-006.explanation: A) Incorrect: DMS is for databases. B) Correct: AppFlow is the no-code integration service with SaaS (Salesforce), SAP, Slack, Google Analytics), with scheduling, filters and light transformations, delivering in S3 or Redshift. C) Incorrect: Transfer Family provides SFTP managed to receive files, does not connect in SaaS APIs. D) Incorrect: MSK is Kafka managed — would require building connectors.

dea-ini-007.text: A company already operates Apache Kafka-based pipelines and wants to migrate to AWS maintaining compatibility with existing Kafka APIs and ecosystem.?
options: Amazon MSK (Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka)
dea-ini-007.explanation: A) Incorrect: Kinesis is the native streaming of AWS, But there is API own — would require rewriting producers and consumers.: EventBridge It's event bus, not Kafka. C) Incorrect: SQS FIFO is an ordered row, not a Kafka cluster. MSK is the managed Apache Kafka — existing Kafka customers continue to operate without code change.

dea-ini-008.text: Why columnary formats like Apache Parquet are preferred in analytical data lakes, compared to CSV?
options: Because they're the only formats accepted by S3
Because they store data line-to-line, ideal for transactional writing
Because they allow you to read only the COLUNAS needed for consultation and compress better, reducing scanned data and cost
Because they're easier to open in Excel
dea-ini-008.explanation: (a) Incorrect: S3 accepts any format. B) Incorrect: line line describes formats as CSV/Avro; Parquet is columnar, optimized for LEITURA C) Correct: in column format, engines as Athena and Redshift Spectrum read only the columns of the query, with compression per column — reductions in 90%+ in scanned bytes are common. D) Incorrect: human legibility is not data lake criterion.

dea-ini-009.text: What is the fundamental difference between approaches ETL and ELT?
options: ELT data processing is not permitted
ETL transforms data ANTES to carry them to the destination; ELT load raw data first and transform DENTRO of destination (e.g. in the data warehouse))
ETL It's always faster than ELT
dea-ini-009.explanation: A) Incorrect: the order of steps changes architecture, costs and tools. ELT (c) Correct: ETL the transformation occurs in the middle of the path (e.g.: job Glue before loading); no ELT the raw data enter first (ex.: COPY no Redshift) and the transformation runs in its own destination with SQL. D) Incorrect: performance depends on case — no universal winner.

dea-ini-010.text: A team needs to run distributed processing jobs using Apache Spark and Apache Hive frameworks with fine cluster control (instance types, libraries, configurations). What service provides managed clusters for these frameworks?
dea-ini-010.explanation: A) Incorrect: Athena execution SQL serverless — gives no cluster control or spins arbitrary Spark jobs (except Athena for Spark, with limited scope). B) Incorrect: Batch calendar containers, is not a cluster of big data frames. C) Incorrect: Lambda has a limit of 15 minutes and is not a Spark cluster. D) Correct: the EMR provides managed big data clusters (Spark, Hive, Presto/Trino, HBase) with full control of instances and settings.

dea-ini-011.text: No. Amazon Kinesis Data Streams, which is a SHARD?
options: The stream capacity unit: each shard supports 1 MB/s (or 1.000 written records and 2 MB/s reading
The maximum retention period for data
dea-ini-011.explanation: A) Incorrect: compression has no relation to shards. B) Correct: the shard is the unit of parallelism and capacity — dimensioning a provided stream is to define how many shards it has. C) Incorrect: retention is a stream configuration (24h standard, up to 365 D) Incorrect: consumers read DE shards; shard is not a consumer.

dea-ini-012.text: A company needs to transfer millions of files from a server on schedule and with integrity validation NFS on-premises for the Amazon S3. What service is specialized in this transfer of ARQUIVOS?
dea-ini-012.explanation: A) Incorrect: Glue transforms and catalogs data; it is not file transfer tool. B) Incorrect: Firehose delivers event streams, does not synchronize file systems. C) Incorrect: DMS (d) Correct: DataSync was made to move files between NFS/SMB/HDFS and S3/EFS/FSx, with scheduling, parallelism and integrity verification.
